title: potentilla subacaulis subsp. albicans
intro: Potentilla subacaulis subsp. albicans, commonly known as the white cinquefoil, is a perennial herbaceous plant in the rose family, Rosaceae. The health benefits of Potentilla subacaulis subsp. albicans include its potential to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds that have been identified in the plant's leaves and flowers.
